label: Square / Flat
description: A straight, flat-cut hem with no points, giving the waistcoat a clean horizontal bottom edge. This streamlined finish reads modern and understated, and is also traditional on certain evening and morning-dress vests. The square hem simplifies the silhouette and works well under a buttoned jacket.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
